info.title: RSVP Identity API
info.description: 2.1.0 (additive, perfil en el registro; supersedes PR #26): POST /auth/register accepts the optional profile givenName, familyName, phone (E.164; separators are removed), country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, default BO), city, locale (es-BO|en-US, default from Accept-Language), timeZone (IANA, default America/La_Paz) and marketingOptIn (default false); an invalid value answers 422 naming the field and nothing is created. The 201 adds `profile`. A body with only email and password keeps working and gets the default profile. GET /users/me (getOwnProfile) returns the signed-in account with its profile, termsVersion/termsAcceptedAt (B6) and marketingOptInAt; PATCH /users/me (updateOwnProfile) is a partial update (keys omitted are kept, null clears givenName, familyName, phone or city; email, roles, termsVersion and unknown keys are a 422). Both act only on the token subject. Names and phone are encrypted at rest and deleted with the account (DELETE /users/me); identity.* events do not carry the profile (AsyncAPI unchanged). 2.0.0 (BREAKING, IDENTIDAD-SEG-003): joining an organization takes the invitee's consent. POST /organizations/{id}/members (addOrganizationMember) is retired: it revealed which e-mails have an account (422 vs 201 with the userId) and created the membership without the person's consent. Instead the owner or an ADMIN invites an e-mail with POST /organizations/{id}/invitations, which answers 202 with the same body whether or not the address has an account; Identity e-mails a 7-day single-use link (identity.organization.invitation-requested.v1, IDENTITY_PUBLIC_APP_URL + /invitaciones?invitacion={id}&token=...). Only the invitee creates the membership, with POST /invitations/{id}/accept, or refuses it with POST /invitations/{id}/decline; GET /invitations lists the open invitations of the signed-in account (only when its e-mail is verified; otherwise the link token is the proof). The owner lists open invitations (GET /organizations/{id}/invitations) and revokes them (DELETE /organizations/{id}/invitations/{invitationId}). Every step is audited. Consumers of addOrganizationMember (the frontend organizations screen) must switch to invitations. 1.7.0 (additive, A24; PR #42): GET /admin/users also accepts email (exact, case-insensitive match, to link the owner of a partner) and ids (comma-separated user ids, at most 100, to show the owners of a page of partners). Only one of query, email or ids per call (422 otherwise). Still ADMIN only (MANAGE_PLATFORM) and audited as users.list with the kind of filter, never its value. 1.6.0 (additive, B6/A22): POST /auth/register accepts an optional termsVersion (the version of the terms and privacy policy the person accepted; stored with the server time). DELETE /users/me (the account owner, confirming with the password) and DELETE /users/{id} (ADMIN) delete the account for real: roles, tokens, memberships and the organizations it owns go with it, every session ends and identity.user.deleted.v1 (AsyncAPI 1.13.0) tells the other services to purge their copies. The last ADMIN cannot be deleted. 1.5.0 (additive, A21): POST /auth/password (signed-in change; ends other sessions, returns a new one), POST /auth/logout-all, PUT/DELETE /users/{id}/suspension (ADMIN; a suspended account gets 403 account-suspended on sign-in and 401 on refresh), DELETE /users/{id}/roles/{role} (ADMIN; never the last role or the last ADMIN; ends the account's sessions) and DELETE /organizations/{id}/members/{userId} (owner or ADMIN removes, a member leaves). User and AdminUser carry status ACTIVE|SUSPENDED. 1.4.0 (additive, B10): POST /oauth/token (OAuth 2.0 client_credentials, RFC 6749 §4.4) for internal services. Each client holds (audience, scope) pairs; notification-service may obtain provider:notification-profile:read (aud provider-catalog-service) and guest:notification-profile:read (aud guest-rsvp-service), one audience per token. Clients and the audience/scopes each may obtain are declared in Identity; secrets are configured as SHA-256 in IDENTITY_SERVICE_CLIENTS. The token carries roles [SERVICE], aud, scope and client_id and lives 5 minutes; it is never issued to a person. 1.3.0 (additive, B4): real password recovery and e-mail verification. POST /auth/password-recovery now stores a single-use token (30 minutes, hash only) and asks Notification to send the link (event identity.user.password-reset-requested.v1); POST /auth/password-reset consumes it, sets the new password and ends every session; sign-up sends a 24-hour verification link (identity.user.email-verification-requested.v1), confirmed with POST /auth/email-verification/confirm and re-sent with POST /auth/email-verification. Registration and the access token expose whether the e-mail is verified (`emailVerified`, claim `email_verified`). 1.2.0 (additive, B9): the access token carries `memberships` [{organizationId, role}], the role of the subject IN each organization. `roles` now lists only the platform roles of the account (membership roles are no longer merged into it); `organizationIds` stays, derived from `memberships`, for visibility only. Consumers decide organization-scoped authority from `memberships` and must treat a token without it (minted by Identity < 1.2.0) as granting no organization management. 1.1.0 (additive, ADMIN only): GET /admin/users?query=&page=&size=, GET /admin/organizations and GET /admin/summary (served by Kong at /identity/admin/*). Reads of the user list and role grants are audited (actor, action, time; never the search text). Account status is always ACTIVE: suspension of accounts does not exist yet.

Set-Cookie.description: `rsvp_refresh` cookie when `X-Session-Transport: cookie` is sent; cleared (Max-Age=0) on logout.
`rsvp_refresh` cookie when `X-Session-Transport: cookie` is sent; cleared (Max-Age=0) on logout.

403.description: The credentials are right but the account is suspended (problem type account-suspended).

200.description: Rotated session. Reusing a consumed refresh token revokes its whole chain and returns 401.

Set-Cookie.description: `rsvp_refresh` cookie when `X-Session-Transport: cookie` is sent; cleared (Max-Age=0) on logout.

requestBody.description: Required unless `X-Session-Transport: cookie`, in which case the body is ignored and the cookie is used (401 when the cookie is absent or revoked).

202.description: Accepted. This response is identical whether or not the account exists.

post.description: Always 202 for a well-formed address. For an existing account, stores the SHA-256 of a single-use token valid 30 minutes (any earlier unused link stops working) and records the e-mail request for Notification. A second request within 60 seconds sends nothing new. `Accept-Language` picks the e-mail language (en-US or es-BO).

requestBody.description: Required unless `X-Session-Transport: cookie`, in which case the body is ignored and the cookie is used.

Set-Cookie.description: `rsvp_refresh` cookie when `X-Session-Transport: cookie` is sent; cleared (Max-Age=0) on logout.

200.description: JWKS (RFC 7517). kid is the RFC 7638 thumbprint.

post.summary: Create an organization; the caller becomes its owner and a PLANNER member (needs MANAGE_ORGANIZATION: PLANNER or ADMIN)

get.summary: Organizations the caller belongs to (ADMIN: all)
Read an organization with its members (members and ADMIN only)

delete.summary: Delete an account (ADMIN only; A22, D-5)
delete.description: Same effect as DELETE /users/me for another account. 409 for one's own account (use DELETE /users/me) or the last ADMIN.

put.summary: Grant a platform role, idempotent (ADMIN only). The first ADMIN comes from the operator command IDENTITY_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL

delete.summary: Revoke a platform role (ADMIN only). Idempotent; 409 for the account's last role or the platform's last ADMIN. Ends the account's sessions.

get.summary: Accounts, optionally filtered by an e-mail fragment, an exact e-mail or a list of ids

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Case-insensitive e-mail fragment, up to 120 characters

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Exact e-mail, case-insensitive (1.2.0). Not combinable with query or ids.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated user ids, at most 100 (1.2.0). Unknown ids are skipped; items keep creation order. Not combinable with query or email.

post.description: Consumes the single-use link of a password-recovery e-mail, sets the new password, marks the e-mail verified and revokes every refresh-token chain of the account (signs it out everywhere). Unknown, used or expired links answer 422 on `token`; a weak password answers 422 on `newPassword` without consuming the link.

Set-Cookie.description: Cleared `rsvp_refresh` cookie (Max-Age=0) when `X-Session-Transport: cookie` is sent.

post.description: Consumes the single-use link of the verification e-mail (24 hours) and marks the account's e-mail verified. Unknown, used or expired links answer 422 on `token`.
Sends a new verification link to the signed-in account. No-op (still 202) when the e-mail is already verified or a link was sent less than 60 seconds ago.
client_credentials only. Internal callers use http://identity-service:8080/oauth/token.

401.description: invalid_client (unknown client or wrong secret; indistinguishable).

post.description: Signed-in password change. A wrong current password answers 422 on currentPassword. Every other session of the account ends; the response is a new session for this device (same transport rules as login).

Set-Cookie.description: `rsvp_refresh` cookie when `X-Session-Transport: cookie` is sent; cleared (Max-Age=0) on logout.

post.description: Ends every refresh-token chain of the caller (all devices). Access tokens already issued expire on their own (15 minutes).

204.description: Signed out everywhere; the cookie is cleared with cookie transport.

put.description: ADMIN only. Sign-in answers 403 account-suspended and refresh 401; every session ends at once. 409 on one's own account.

delete.description: The owner or an ADMIN removes a member; a member removes themselves (leaves). The owner cannot be removed (409). Not visible or not a member: 404.

get.description: Any role with a person's Bearer token. The account is the token subject (no id in the path). Cache-Control: no-store. 401 if the account no longer exists.

patch.description: Partial update of the token subject's profile under a row lock. 422 names the invalid or read-only field and never echoes its value.

delete.description: Deletes the signed-in account for real, confirming with the password: roles, single-use tokens, memberships and the organizations it owns are removed, every session ends and identity.user.deleted.v1 is published through the outbox so every service purges its copies. 409 for the last ADMIN.

post.summary: Invite an e-mail as HOST or PLANNER member (owner or ADMIN).
post.description: 202 with the same body whether or not the address has an account. Nothing is created in the organization until the invitee accepts. Inviting the same address again within 60 seconds with the same role returns the open invitation and sends nothing new; otherwise a new invitation replaces the open one (only the latest link works). 409: the address already belongs to a member, or the organization has 50 open invitations. Not a member: 404; a member who is not the owner: 403.

202.description: Invitation recorded; the e-mail is on its way.

get.summary: Open invitations of the organization (owner or ADMIN).

delete.summary: Revoke an open invitation (owner or ADMIN). Its link stops working.

get.summary: Open invitations addressed to the signed-in account's e-mail.
get.description: Listed only when the account's e-mail is verified (emailVerified true); an unverified account answers from the e-mail link.

post.summary: Accept an invitation: creates the membership (its next access token lists the organization).
post.description: 404 when the invitation does not exist, is not addressed to the caller's e-mail, or is no longer open (answered, revoked, expired). 403 when the account's e-mail is not verified and token is missing or wrong. 409 when the caller already belongs to the organization. Of two simultaneous answers only one succeeds.

post.summary: Decline an invitation. Final: the link stops working.

password.description: Length-based policy; at most 72 UTF-8 bytes.

termsVersion.description: B6: version of the terms and privacy policy the person accepted (for example 2026-11-21-borrador). Optional for clients released before 1.6.0.

givenName.description: Optional (since 2.1.0). Trimmed; 1 to 80 characters, no control characters. Personal data (encrypted at rest).

familyName.description: Optional (since 2.1.0). Trimmed; 1 to 80 characters, no control characters. Personal data (encrypted at rest).

phone.description: Optional (since 2.1.0). E.164 (for example +59170000000). Spaces, dots, dashes and parentheses are removed before the check. Personal data (encrypted at rest).

city.description: Optional (since 2.1.0). Free text, trimmed; 1 to 80 characters.

locale.description: Optional (since 2.1.0). Preferred language. Default: en-US when Accept-Language prefers English, es-BO otherwise. It also picks the language of the verification e-mail.

marketingOptIn.description: Optional (since 2.1.0). Consent to product news. The time it was given is recorded (marketingOptInAt).

accessToken.description: RS256 JWT. Claims: iss, sub, roles[] (platform roles), organizationIds[], memberships[] ({organizationId, role}), iat, exp, jti.

refreshToken.description: Opaque, single use, 30 days. Omitted when `X-Session-Transport: cookie` (it is in the httpOnly cookie).

emailVerified.description: Since 1.3.0. Always false right after sign-up: a verification e-mail is on its way.

profile.description: Since 2.1.0: the profile as stored (defaults filled in).

AccessTokenClaims.description: Payload of accessToken, consumed by every service. Organization-scoped authority comes only from `memberships`.

roles.description: Platform roles of the account. Never contains roles held in an organization (see `memberships`).

organizationIds.description: Organizations the subject belongs to in any role (derived from `memberships`). Visibility only: never a source of authority.

memberships.description: Since 1.2.0. The role of the subject in each organization it belongs to. A role here applies only to its organization.

email_verified.description: Since 1.3.0. Whether the account proved it owns its e-mail.

token.description: The `token` query parameter of the e-mail link.

ClientCredentialsRequest.description: Form (application/x-www-form-urlencoded) per RFC 6749; JSON is also accepted, with snake_case or camelCase names (grantType, clientId, clientSecret). Client credentials go preferably in HTTP Basic.

scope.description: Space separated. A token is for one audience, selected by its scopes: scopes of two audiences in one request give invalid_scope. Without scope, a client with a single audience gets all its scopes and a client with several (notification-service: provider-catalog-service and guest-rsvp-service) gets invalid_scope.

access_token.description: RS256 JWT. Claims: iss, sub (client id), client_id, aud, scope, roles [SERVICE], iat, exp, jti.

password.description: The current password, to confirm the deletion.

role.description: Role IN this organization (memberships claim). Never a platform role.

OrganizationInvitation.description: An open invitation as its organization's owner sees it. Identical in shape whether or not the address has an account; never carries a user id.

email.description: Normalized (trimmed, lower-case). Kept only while the invitation is open.

role.description: Role IN this organization (memberships claim). Never a platform role.
Role IN this organization (memberships claim). Never a platform role.

emailVerified.description: false: the account has not proven its e-mail, so items is empty; the invitee answers from the e-mail link (token).

token.description: The token of the e-mail link. Required while the account's e-mail is not verified; ignored otherwise.

role.description: Role IN this organization (memberships claim). Never a platform role.

UserProfile.description: Since 2.1.0. Unset optional values are null, so the shape is stable.

UpdateProfileRequest.description: Partial update (since 2.1.0): only the keys sent change. null clears givenName, familyName, phone or city; country, locale, timeZone and marketingOptIn cannot be null. Any other key (email, roles, termsVersion...) answers 422 naming it.

marketingOptIn.description: true records the time of the consent (kept if it was already given); false clears it.

termsVersion.description: B6: accepted version of the terms and privacy policy; null if none was recorded.

marketingOptInAt.description: When the current marketing consent was given; null without consent.

updatedAt.description: Last profile change (the creation time if it never changed).

Forbidden.description: Authenticated, but the role or membership does not allow this

NotFound.description: Unknown organization, or one the caller does not belong to (indistinguishable by design)

SessionTransport.name: X-Session-Transport
SessionTransport.description: `cookie` (web): the refresh token travels only in the `rsvp_refresh` cookie (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict, Path=/identity/auth, 30 days) and is omitted from bodies. Absent (mobile): the refresh token is in the body. The custom header forces a CORS preflight, which with SameSite=Strict is the CSRF defence.

AcceptLanguage.name: Accept-Language
AcceptLanguage.description: Language of the account e-mail: en-US when it starts with `en`, es-BO otherwise.
